build_package_register: build a PackageRegister instance to manage community dataset packages from a remote index file
create_dataset_package: create a DatasetPackage from JSON data containing namespace, name, and source information
list_package_builders: list all registered dataset builders from the community package index
download_and_cache_package: download and cache a community dataset package from its source to the local module path
list_ds_packages_for_namespace: list dataset packages found in a specific directory for a given namespace
